form_analysis.feedback: Comprehensive aftercare form for laser nail fungus treatment with strong emphasis on the extended treatment timeline and reinfection prevention. Excellent guidance on nail growth monitoring and combination therapies.

form_data.introduction: This aftercare is for laser treatment of onychomycosis (fungal nail infection). Laser heats nail plate to kill fungus. Requires multiple sessions and extensive follow-up as nails grow slowly.

instructions.general_directive: Follow for the entire nail growth period (9-12 months). Nail fungus treatment requires patience and consistent aftercare.

sections.title: Laser Nail Fungus Mechanism
sections.content: Near-infrared laser passes through nail plate, heating to 45-50°C to kill fungus without damaging nail or surrounding tissue. Multiple sessions needed as fungus is throughout nail.

sections.title: Extended Treatment Timeline
items: Initial improvement: 3-6 months as new nail grows.
Multiple sessions: 3-6 treatments at 4-6 week intervals.
Complete clearance: 9-12 months for toenails, 4-6 months for fingernails.

sections.title: Reinfection Prevention (CRITICAL)
items: Change socks daily, or twice if sweaty.

sections.title: Nail Care During Treatment
items: File thickened nails to reduce bulk.
Avoid nail polish which traps moisture.
Consider antifungal nail lacquer between sessions.

sections.title: Monitoring Nail Growth
sections.content: Healthy new nail grows from cuticle outward. Monitor: 1) Clear nail at base 2) Reduction in thickening 3) Improved color 4) Decreased debris under nail. Take monthly photos to track progress.

sections.title: Realistic Expectations
items: Severely damaged nails may not fully recover.
Recurrence possible if preventive measures not maintained.
Combination with oral/topical antifungals increases success.
